rule: Highest average of mean capture (share of severe passengers found in the top 5%, 10%, 20% and 30% of the ranked queue, averaged over those four levels) across all outer folds. Higher score wins even if the gap is small.
note: If the lead is smaller than the fold-to-fold spread, report that the model was selected by a pre-set rule, not shown to be clearly better. Selecting among five models also makes the winner's cross-validated score slightly optimistic.
